name: Quality Assurance
description: Evaluation system that samples contacts, scores them against calibrated scorecards, and routes coaching and compliance findings back into WFM schedules and knowledge updates.
roleInCenter: Quality control loop: measure what good looks like, catch compliance and coaching gaps, and make improvement actionable.

glossary.definition: A scored assessment of one sampled contact against a scorecard
The weighted rubric of sections and items defining expected behaviors
A scorecard item (e.g. skipped identity verification) that zeroes the entire evaluation
Evaluators score the same contact(s) and reconcile variance so scores mean the same thing across people
Whether wrap-up codes assigned by agents match observed contact content
Which contacts get evaluated: random, targeted (speech analytics flags), or full coverage
Agent dispute workflow for contested evaluations with re-score by second evaluator
Simultaneous audio and screen recording of the interaction
Targeted development actions derived from evaluation trends
Process-level review (drivers, root causes) beyond per-contact transactional scoring
Automated evaluation of every contact via speech/text analytics rules
Controlled vocabulary for the underlying driver of a quality failure (stale KM, tool gap, training gap)

children.name: Self-Evaluation
children.description: Agent scores own contact before evaluator view unlocks

children.name: Peer QA
children.description: Team-level scoring rotations for culture and calibration

children.name: Automated Full Coverage
children.description: Rule-based auto QA on all contacts, human QA on flagged subsets

children.name: Resolved - First Contact
children.description: Need closed in one contact; maps to engine journey terminal stage

children.name: Escalated and Resolved
children.description: Closed after tier-2 or supervisor escalation

children.name: Transferred - Stranded
children.description: Never answered post-transfer; defect for routing review

children.name: Callback Required
children.description: Promise made; fulfillment must be verified

children.name: Unresolved - Policy Limit
children.description: Company policy prevents resolution; candidate for policy review

children.name: Wrong Party Issue
children.description: Authentication or disclosure error; auto-fail review

children.name: Knowledge Gap
children.description: Agent lacked correct answer or used stale content

children.name: Policy Conflict
children.description: Rules contradict each other or customer reality

children.name: Process Design Gap
children.description: Routing or flow design misleads agent or customer

children.name: Volume Pressure
children.description: Occupancy or backlog forcing rushed handling

metrics.name: Average QA Score
metrics.definition: Mean evaluation score across sampled contacts in period

metrics.name: Auto-Fail Rate
metrics.definition: Share of evaluations with an auto-fail item triggered

metrics.name: Evaluation Coverage
metrics.definition: Share of contacts receiving any evaluation, human or automated

metrics.name: Calibration Variance
metrics.definition: Score spread across evaluators on the same calibration contact; >10 pts signals calibration debt

metrics.name: Disposition Accuracy
metrics.definition: Share of contacts whose wrap code matches QA-verified outcome

metrics.name: Coaching Cycle Time
metrics.definition: Days from evaluation to completed coaching session

scoringModel.name: CXOS Universal Contact Scorecard
scoringModel.note: Weights set 2026-10-18 with the local Strands Decider (strands-decider-2B-hobson-v21, see docs/DECIDER.md): compliance floor of 20+ points confirmed (noul 0.858); compliance emphasis held at 'moderate', not strict (score 0.535, conf 0.494); largest-dimension question came back a statistical tie between accuracy_resolution 0.419 and compliance_security 0.422 (conf 0.278) so accuracy stays nominally largest until real QA traffic revisits it. Dimension extensions for a vertical should re-ask these questions on that vertical's traffic.

dimensions.name: Compliance & Security
dimensions.description: Identity verification strength, required disclosures, data handling, and payment security behaviors
sampleCriteria: No PII exposure on recorded line

dimensions.name: Accuracy & Resolution
dimensions.description: Correct substantive answer, correct process, and genuine resolution of the customer need

dimensions.name: Process & Efficiency
dimensions.description: Navigation, tooling, and handle-time discipline without rushing the customer
sampleCriteria: Minimal dead air or redundant holds

dimensions.name: Communication & Empathy
dimensions.description: Active listening, plain language, acknowledgment, and tone matched to customer sentiment

dimensions.name: Brand Experience Close
dimensions.description: Recap, next steps, and closing that leave the customer confident the issue is owned
sampleCriteria: Clear recap of actions and timing

failureModes.name: Gotcha QA
failureModes.signal: Agent trust pulse falls while scores rise; appeals spike on minor items
failureModes.mitigation: Weighted rubric with behavior criteria, calibration, and appeal path

failureModes.name: Calibration Drift
failureModes.signal: Evaluator variance trending upward; scores diverge by team
failureModes.mitigation: Monthly calibration sessions; shared anchors per scorecard item

failureModes.name: Cherry-Picked Sampling
failureModes.signal: Coverage stats nominal but variance of sampled AHT far below population
failureModes.mitigation: Deterministic random sampling algorithm; audit trail on sample selection

failureModes.name: Score-Outcome Disconnect
failureModes.signal: QA rising while CSAT and FCR fall
failureModes.mitigation: Correlation review of qa_score_avg vs csat and fcr_rate each period

exchanges: Auto-QA rule hits queue targeted human evaluation
Transcripts and flags embedded in evaluation evidence
Coaching time scheduled as planned shrinkage
Burnout-linked soft-skill trends shared with occupancy reviews
Root-cause knowledge gaps open KM article review tickets
Article quality scores feed KM curation backlog
Low-score contacts cross-referenced against survey verbatims for driver corroboration

stateVariables.description: Continuous-time conjugate Beta-Binomial and Dirichlet concentration vector tracking posterior rubric mastery across K dimensions
Cross-evaluator score variance on shared anchor contacts measuring inter-rater calibration divergence
Strands 2B System-One Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Brier residual between predicted score probabilities and human gold consensus
Risk-weighted importance sampling density over contact feature manifold x prioritizing compliance anomaly and high-uncertainty interactions
Agent behavioral mastery state evolving under targeted coaching interventions and natural skill forgetting

differentialEquations.name: Continuous Beta-Binomial & Dirichlet Rubric Posterior Flow
differentialEquations.formula: dalpha_qa(t) cdot dt^-1 = - lambda_forget cdot (alpha_qa(t) - alpha_prior) + p_sample(x, t) cdot y_obs(t)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Conjugate Dirichlet concentration parameters update continuously with importance-sampled evaluation observations y_obs while exponentially discounting stale evidence

differentialEquations.name: Inter-Rater Calibration Drift Diffusion
differentialEquations.formula: dV_rater(t) = (sigma_drift^2 - kappa_cal cdot I_session(t) cdot V_rater(t)) dt + xi_rater cdot sqrt(V_rater(t)) dW_t
differentialEquations.interpretation: Evaluator score variance grows linearly via natural interpretive drift sigma_drift^2 and contracts exponentially during consensus calibration sessions I_session(t)

differentialEquations.name: Strands 2B System-One Brier & ECE Calibration Dynamics
differentialEquations.formula: dE_cal(t) cdot dt^-1 = - eta_temp cdot grad_T Brier(p_decider(t), y_gold(t)) + gamma_shift cdot D_kl(P_live(t) || P_anchor)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Temperature-scaled Strands 2B System-One decider drives Brier and ECE residuals down at rate eta_temp while covariate shift D_kl injects calibration pressure

scaleInvariants: Conjugate sufficient-statistic closure: Beta-Binomial and Dirichlet rubric posteriors update in O(1) time and memory per scored interaction
Horvitz-Thompson unbiasedness: inverse propensity weighting by p_sample(x, t)^-1 preserves unbiased center-wide QA means under 100x targeted risk oversampling
Proper scoring rule convexity: Brier score decomposition into reliability, resolution, and uncertainty remains invariant under affine scorecard rescaling
